title: Bad Apples in the Kitchen: How LLM Teams Detect, Correct, and Calibrate Against Their Misaligned Members
abstract: arXiv:2611.22342v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: What protects an LLM team when one teammate quietly goes wrong? Most multi-agent LLM work assumes cooperative partners and inspects chat between turns before acting. Real-time embodied cooperation does not allow this pause: chat runs alongside action, so a teammate whose words stay cooperative while behavior diverges can cause damage faster than the team can name what is happening. We study this case by injecting three theory-grounded misaligned agents into a custom four-player Overcooked environment, each stressing a different joint-action layer (speech-action mismatch, role invasion, and aggregate-progress disruption), and decompose robustness into three sequential gates of detection, correction, and calibration through a 3x4x2 design (n=720 episodes). translated_title: 厨房里的坏苹果：LLM团队如何检测、纠正并防范其失准成员
translated_abstract: 当一名队友悄悄出错时，是什么在保护LLM团队？大多数多智能体LLM研究假设合作者是协作性的，并在行动前的轮次间隙检查对话。实时具身协作不允许这种停顿：对话与行动并行进行，因此一个言语保持协作但行为却发生偏离的队友，可能比团队说出发生了什么更快地造成损害。我们通过将三个基于理论的失准智能体注入定制化的四人Overcooked环境来研究这一情形，每个智能体分别对不同的联合行动层施加压力（言语-行动不匹配、角色入侵和总体进度破坏），并通过3x4x2实验设计（n=720回合）将鲁棒性分解为检测、纠正和校准三个连续的关口。几乎所有“捣乱者”最终都会被指认出来，但只有当归因与情境诊断出现在同一句话中时，团队恢复才会随之发生；直接的来源归因提示改善了……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文在实时具身协作环境Overcooked中注入三种基于理论的失准智能体，将LLM团队鲁棒性分解为检测、纠正与校准三个连续阶段，并发现只有当同一句话中同时包含归因和情境诊断时团队才能实现恢复。
en_tdlr: This paper injects three theory-grounded misaligned agents into a real-time embodied Overcooked environment, decomposes LLM team robustness into sequential gates of detection, correction, and calibration, and finds that recovery occurs only when attribution and situational diagnosis appear within the same utterance.
